name: Elio Buzzers v4
description:
Project Elio Buzzers are a set of quiz buzzers designed for trivia, game shows, and classroom use. Each unit features front and back RGB NeoPixel indicators, a satisfying pushbutton, and connects to the rest of the system with CAT5 Ethernet cables. The buzzers are controlled by a central ESP32 hub and daisy chained together.

Includes eight buzzers (4 on each team), a remote clear button, and one main control box.
